notes: 0.3.23: Adding cards to a lot works again: a card stays in the lot list the moment it is added, a card can be deleted right after a scan without the changed-since-loaded message, and Delete lot works, keeping the cards or archiving them. Accepting a price in the card panel shows the number you accepted on the panel and the row. Creating a card with a pasted photo works again: the photo was hitting the small request limit meant for sign-in, and that door is now the same size as the other picture doors. Dropping a picture onto a card in the side panel works inside the app now; before this the app window swallowed the drop. The eBay line at the top of Benchmark Pricing is gone. Known: a typed price with cents on the To review tab saves as whole dollars; fix in the next release.
